purpose: Showcase the Granola Chat feature via a self-typing prompt-cycling demo card that proves the product 'remembers' meeting context.

motion.detail: framer-motion stagger typing (~22 chars/s), rest 2400ms with blinking caret, select-highlight 650ms, then swap to next prompt via spring chip remount (bounce .6); ~6.0s per prompt cycle; starts when card >=60% in view
motion.reducedMotionFallback: shows first prompt fully typed and selected, no cycling
